subject: general
question: Stand Up India scheme aims at supporting entrepreneurship to _______ community of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scheduled Caste**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Stand Up India scheme aims to **support entrepreneurship among women, Scheduled Castes (SC), and Scheduled Tribes (ST).**
 
• The goal is to enable these underserved sectors of the population to start new enterprises and become economically self-sufficient.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Business Person:**

 
 
• This term generally refers to any individual who owns and operates a business.
 
• These are individuals who undertake the **financial risk of the initiation, operation, and management of a business.**
 
 
 
• **Construction Workers: **
 
 
• This group refers to **manual laborers who work in construction.**
 
• They perform tasks involving **physical labor at construction sites and may operate hand and power tools of all types.**
 
 
 
• **Below Poverty Line (BPL):**
 
 
• This term refers to a benchmark set by the government of India to identify economically disadvantaged people who need government assistance.
 
• The BPL benchmark is based on various parameters including **income, size of land holdings, and literacy rate.**
 
• According to **India's Development Goals, people below the poverty line should be supported with social security and welfare programs.**
